review:
Dungeon Quest is an early 5x7 Nolimit City fantasy slot built around ore symbols. Power Stone randomly turns a 2x2 area wild and converts every instance of one ore, and Gem Forge swaps all ores for a single randomly chosen one.

Three scatters award four Alchemy Spins, each focused on one ore type, which turns wild and stays. Nolimit rates it Medium volatility with a 450x cap. It's the gentlest game in the catalogue, ideal for long, low-risk play.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
